subject: [PATCH] btrfs: abort transaction before releasing tree_log_mutex on commit failure

2026-08-19.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Btrfs file system where, on transaction commit failure, the tree log mutex is released before aborting the transaction. This allows a subsequent log sync to write superblocks that point to tree blocks not yet written to disk, causing a parent transid mismatch on next mount. The patch restores the correct ordering by aborting the transaction while still holding the tree log mutex, which records the fs error and prevents the superblock from being written.
